column1: # What every child knows about the things in the pictures, for the quiz
# ("What can fly? Tree, bird or house?"). One line per picture, the same in
# Size and weight are rough ("-" = none, e.g. a number or a body part); the
# quiz compares only things that differ a lot.
# yes / unclear: space-separated properties. Everything else is a clear
# "no". A thing is offered as a wrong answer only if it is a clear no, so
# anything people might argue about (can a chicken fly?) goes to unclear.
# Properties: animal flies swims walks talks eat drink wear plant wheels
